visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female staff member wearing a face mask, a gray shirt, and a red apron serves a plate of fried rice. The scene is set inside a busy breakfast shop kitchen area with stainless steel counters and various food preparation equipment visible in the background. (2) A close-up shot focuses on a chicken sandwich with multiple layers including a crispy fried chicken patty, a fried egg, and shredded lettuce. The sandwich is held in a clear plastic bag. (3) A male chef wearing an orange shirt and a black apron is seen from behind, vigorously stir-frying rice on a large, flat metal griddle. Steam rises from the hot surface. (4) The female staff member from the first phase is shown in a medium shot, talking directly toward the camera while holding a white face mask in her hand. (5) A hand holds a blue pen and writes an order on a small piece of white paper resting on a countertop next to a menu. (6) A series of close-ups depict various food items: a corn egg pancake being dipped into a brown sauce, fried rice being drizzled with ketchup and scooped up with a white spoon, and a large metal ladle pouring milk tea into a clear plastic cup. (7) The camera pans to show the interior of the shop with several tables and then cuts to an exterior wide shot of the storefront. The storefront features a pink sign and several customers sitting at tables on the sidewalk under an awning.

(8) [Subtitle]: 點餐是自己拿空白紙手寫. (9) [Subtitle]: 麥香雞土司一定要點. (10) [Subtitle]: 自家醃製. (11) [Subtitle]: 炸到外酥內軟. (12) [Subtitle]: 鹹香帶有胡椒微辣感. (13) [Subtitle]: 玉米蛋餅也很推. (14) [Subtitle]: 外皮煎得微酥. (15) [Subtitle]: 涮嘴又順口. (16) [Subtitle]: 鐵板炒飯也很受歡迎. (17) [Subtitle]: 用番茄醬調味. (18) [Subtitle]: 鹹甜開胃. (19) [Subtitle]: 吃得到火腿和炒蛋. (20) [Subtitle]: 記得配一杯. (21) [Subtitle]: 他們自製的咖啡牛奶. (22) [Subtitle]: 還有清爽的紅茶. (23) [Subtitle]: 早餐店開到下午. (24) [Subtitle]: 想吃隨時來. (25) [Subtitle]: 我們是虎麗笑嗨嗨. (26) [Subtitle]: 瀋陽街 夏一跳麥香雞. [Subtitle]: 高雄市三民區瀋陽街163號. (27) [Subtitle]: 下次再一起吃美食囉.
